name: Yizhi Ben Xiang Yue: Baituo Liao Jingjiren
original_name: 一直奔向月：拜托了经纪人
source: You play the manager of an entertainment company, charged with managing six attractive and talented men. Part raising simulator, part dating game, will you be able to bring them to the top?
translation: 你扮演一家娱乐公司的经理，负责管理六名有魅力、有才华的男人。一半是饲养模拟器，一半是约会游戏，你能带领他们登上巅峰吗？
